connector.name: Odoo Pulse
connector.registryDescription: An AI business analyst for Odoo ERP (18+) - one-call reports with verdicts, over MCP
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package odoo-pulse. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the minhhq-a1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ODOO_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Odoo instance, e.g. https://acme.odoo.com

env.name: ODOO_API_KEY
env.description: Odoo API key (used as the password)

env.name: ODOO_READ_ONLY
env.description: Block all write methods when true (default true)
